svg.aria-label: The production readiness rubric scored across the four systems: ConvFinQA Agent six of nine, with the judge and guardrails partial and the scale path designed only; DataAgentBench Loop five of nine, with the judge not needed by design, cost and release partial and the scale path designed only, because nothing is deployed; Data Pilot nine of nine shipped; Transcript RAG five of nine. Every dimension that is not shipped is named with its reason on the system's own scorecard.
svg.title: 6 / 9, 5 / 9, 9 / 9, 5 / 9 — and the gaps are named, not rounded up

g.title: the nine dimensions run in order: evals, judge, gate, loop, guardrails, tracing, cost, release, scale. Accent is shipped, a plain outline is partial, a dashed outline is designed only, a dash is not needed by design.
ConvFinQA Agent · 6 of 9 shipped · the LLM judge and the guardrails are partial, and the scale path is designed only

DataAgentBench Loop · 5 of 9 shipped · an SQL-writing agent taken from 0.440 to 0.904 Pass@1 by a loop that scores the statement; the judge is not needed for validator-graded answers, cost and release are partial and scale is a design because nothing is deployed
Data Pilot · 9 of 9 dimensions shipped · governed natural-language to SQL with row-level security, and rung 100 sized by measurement
Transcript RAG · 5 of 9 shipped · an evaluation-first retrieval workbench whose operating half is the thinner one
